A '''Wistie''' was captured by thugs of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla Besadii the Elder]] and transported to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. There, the [[Wistie/Legends|Wistie]] [[Youngling/Legends|child]] was released into a garden to serve as illumination. The Wistie met the [[Ghostling]] [[Prince/Legends|princess]], [[Arawynne]], and guided her through the garden, aided by the [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]], [[Oo Wen]].
